title: Abakhi Bezakhiwo Zamatshe
intro: Cabanga ngempucuko enamandla, eneziphiwo zamandla namakhono, iqopha izindlu ezinkulu ezintabeni. Leli qembu lalinokuchuma okukhulu kanye nekhono eliyingqayizivele lokwakha. Kodwa-ke, naphezu kokuthola izixwayiso ezicacile, bakhetha indlela eyayizoholela esiphethweni esimangalisayo nesingenakulibaleka. Ungalibona leli qembu elindaba yalo isebenza njengesifundo esijulile kubo bonke abacabangayo?
clues: Sanikwa amandla nekhono, okwasenza sakwazi ukuqopha izindlu ezinhle kakhulu ezintabeni.
Sanikwa isibonakaliso esicacile esivela ku-Allah, isidalwa esiyingqayizivele okwakufanele sishiywe singaphazanyiswa ukuze sidle.
Umphakathi wethu waba nokuzikhukhumeza, waphonsela inselelo umyalezo waphezulu owawulethwe yisithunywa esivela phakathi kwethu.
Sakha uzungu lokulimaza isibonakaliso esimangalisayo, naphezu kwezixwayiso zesijeziso esinzima.
Sawulahla umyalo wokuvumela lesi silwane esikhethekile siphuze emthonjeni wethu ngezinsuku ezishintshanayo.
Sabhekana nesiphetho esibuhlungu, sashaywa ukuqhuma okukodwa okwesabekayo ngemva kwesenzo sethu sokweqa umthetho.
arabic: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةًۭ ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verse: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers. (26:158)
